subject: Trial engagement: scope, success metrics & critical-bug escalation
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novushealth.io>, procurement@novushealth.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Trial engagement: scope, success metrics & critical-bug escalation

Thanks for the call this morning, Samira — good alignment overall. Recap and concrete next steps below so we can get your trial running next week.

High-level scope (what we agreed):
- 4-week trial connecting Novus sandbox to Redwood Hosted API (private project, isolated data)
- Primary use case: clinical note summarization + structured extraction for care coordination
- Two evaluation modes: batch reprocessing of historical notes (dataset A) and live-integration (API calls from your staging environment)

Proposed success criteria (we'll collect these automatically and include in the final report):
1) Latency: 95th percentile token latency < 300ms for staged calls under normal concurrency
2) Quality: entity extraction recall >= 0.92 on the provided evaluation set (dataset A)
3) Cost: projected unit cost <= $0.70 per 1k tokens for steady-state volume (with suggested quantization profile)
4) Security: audit log capture and retention policy validated against your SOC checklist

Evaluation plan & timeline (owners):
- Week 0 (by 2026-12-03): dataset ingestion & mapping — owner: Monica Patel (tech lead) — see attached novus_trial_mop_v1.xlsx
- Week 1 (2026-12-06 to 12-10): integration tests (staging) — owner: Monica + Novus Dev Lead
- Week 2 (2026-12-13 to 12-17): batch reprocessing + metric collection — owner: Monica + Evelyn Hart (CS metrics)
- Week 3 (2026-12-20): live-integration smoke tests + SLA validation — owner: Monica + Rishi (commercial)
- Week 4 (2026-12-27): final report & decision meeting — owner: Rishi + Marissa Cole (customer success)

Known risks we flagged on the call:
- PHI/audit log requirements (we will provide KMS/HSM integration options and a redacted audit sample)
- Variable prompt lengths may impact batching and latency at peak concurrency

Immediate asks / next steps (action owners):
- Novus: confirm dataset access and test credentials by EOD 2026-12-02 (Samira / Dev Team Lead)
- Redwood: provide trial MOP and temporary config recommendations (Rishi / Monica) — attached
- Procurement: share any template PO or timelines; we can accept standard PO + SOW (cc'd procurement)

If anything here doesn't match your understanding, flag it and we'll update. I propose a 30-min checkpoint on 2026-12-07 to review week-1 results.

Best,
Rishi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0189

Subject: Re: Trial engagement: scope, success metrics & critical-bug escalation

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. Confirming we can provide dataset access by Friday. A couple of urgent items from our side: 

1) Compliance/audit: we need an example audit log export format for SOC review (can you point to a sample?)

2) Performance blocker discovered by our dev lead during an initial smoke: when we batch >8 long documents (each ~5k tokens) the API intermittently returns 500s and the request hangs until timeout; this blocks our batch reprocessing plan. Can Redwood confirm whether there are known limits or a recommended temporary config? If this requires an engineering patch, we need an ETA because our procurement window is tight (we'd like this to be resolvable before PO issuance).

We can make the test environment available tonight for a short reproducer. Please advise next steps/owners.

-Samira
Senior Product Manager | Novus Health
samira.k@novushealth.io

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@novushealth.io>, Dev Team Lead <dev.lead@novushealth.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Trial engagement: scope, success metrics & critical-bug escalation

Hi Samira — thanks for the quick repro offer. Monica from Redwood infra here; I dug into logs from our staging cluster and here's what we know and recommended immediate mitigations.

Root cause (current hypothesis):
- The 500s appear correlated with concurrent large-batch requests when KV cache memory spikes and the runtime's batch allocator hits an OOM path on a specific kernel for long sequences. We have a known edge on quantized kernels that surfaces at scale for very long prompts with batch size > 8.

Temporary mitigations you can apply today (no code change on your side):
- Limit batch size to 8 for long-doc jobs (headers or client-side limiter)
- Use model alias model-quantized-v2 (we can route your trial traffic to this variant; it avoids the problematic kernel)
- Enable stream_fallback=true in the client to reduce peak memory at the cost of slightly higher per-token latency

Planned fixes and timeline (owners):
- Immediate: Monica will prod a routing change to pin Novus trial traffic to model-quantized-v2 within 6 hours of confirmation (owner: monica@redwood.ai)
- 48h: hotfix to the batch allocator to avoid OOM edge for long sequences (owner: infra-team oncall; target window 2026-12-05 18:00 PST)
- 72h: full regression test + rollout to standard quantized models (owner: infra release lead; escalation -> Markus Klein if delayed)

Temporary resources attached: a short diagram of the proposed partial-order-of-operations and the fallback steps (poa_sop_diagram.png) and an excerpt of our SLA/uptime terms for trial customers (redwood-sla-excerpt.pdf).

Test instructions for your Dev Lead:
1) Send one reproducer payload to staging with batch_size=12 and long docs; collect X-Request-Id from response header.
2) If you hit 500, rerun with batch_size=8 to confirm.
3) Share logs + request id and I will correlate with our cluster traces.

If we can't mitigate within 72h we'll escalate to engineering leadership and propose a temporary usage credit if Novus' evaluation is materially impacted. For now, let's route trial traffic to model-quantized-v2 and reduce batch size for the batch reprocessing step.

I'll start the routing change now if you approve.

—Monica
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Trial engagement: scope, success metrics & critical-bug escalation

Samira / Novus team — looping in engineering leadership to confirm escalation path and mitigation SLAs. Appreciate the clear repro notes.

What Redwood will commit to now: 
- We will pin Novus trial traffic to model-quantized-v2 for the duration of the trial (effective within 6 hours of this message).
- Monica's team will ship the hotfix within 48 hours of the initial repro correlation; if that hotfix slips beyond 72 hours we will escalate to me and provide a written remediation plan and timeline.
- If Novus' evaluation is materially impaired by an infra issue (e.g., regression preventing batch evaluation), we'll offer a proportional usage credit to be negotiated by Rishi and Procurement.

Checkpoint: let's meet 12/07 14:00 PST for a status update after Week-1 integration. Rishi will send a calendar invite.

Action items (owners):
- Monica: apply routing change and confirm (by 2026-12-05 16:00 PST)
- Novus Dev Lead: send repro + X-Request-Id immediately after a failing request
- Rishi/Marissa: align procurement cadence and credit discussion if needed

Thanks — we'll keep this thread as the primary escalation record.

Markus Klein
